# **SQL Server Authentication Setup Guide**

This guide walks through installing Microsoft SQL Server 2022 Express and configuring it to use a dedicated username and password (sa) for local application development.

## **Phase 1: Downloading the Software**

Download official packages from Microsoft:

**Microsoft SQL Server 2022 Express Edition:**  
The core database engine.  
([https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=104781](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=104781))

## **Phase 2: Installation**

### **Step 1: Install the Database Engine**

1. Run the downloaded SQL Server Express installer.  
2. Choose the **Basic** installation type.  
3. Accept the licensing terms and click **Install**.  
4. Once completed, leave the screen open and note the Instance Name

![][image1]

### **Step 2: Install the Management Interface (SSMS)**

1. Click on install SSMS in the above window or click the link  ([https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/ssms/install/install](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/ssms/install/install))  
2. Run the SSMS installer.  
3. Click **Install** using the default directory path.  
4. Restart the computer if the installer prompts you to do so.

## **Phase 3: Configuring Username & Password Access**

### **Step 1: Log in for the First Time**

1. Open **SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS)** from the Windows Start Menu.  
2. A **Connect to Server** window will appear. Fill it out exactly like this:  
   * **Server name:** .\\SQLEXPRESS  
   * **Authentication:** Windows Authentication  
   * **Trust Server Certificate:** Check this box.  
3. Click **Connect**. The main interface will unlock.

### **Step 2: Turn on Mixed Mode Security**

1. On the far-left panel (Object Explorer), right-click the very top item (the server name) and select **Properties**.  
2. In the window that opens, click the **Security** page on the left side.  
3. Under the "Server authentication" section, change the selection to **SQL Server and Windows Authentication mode**.  
4. Click **OK** at the bottom.

### **Step 3: Enable the 'sa' User and Set a Password**

1. In the far-left panel, double-click the **Security** folder to expand it, then double-click the **Logins** folder.  
2. Find the user named **sa**, right-click it, and select **Properties**.  
3. On the **General** page:  
   * Type a strong password into the **Password** and **Confirm Password** fields. Write this password down; your software will need it.  
4. On the **Status** page (selectable on the left side of the window):  
   * Under "Login", select **Enabled**.  
5. Click **OK** at the bottom.

### **Step 4: Restart the Server Engine**

1. Go back to the far-left panel, right-click the very top item (the server name), and select **Restart**.  
2. Click **Yes** when Windows asks if you are sure. The database service will reboot to apply the new security rules

## **Phase 4: Create Database and Table**


1. Open the SQL Server Management Studio and connect with the database server**(Phase 3, Step 1\)**  
2. Right click on the “Database” folder, New Database  
3. Create a new database with the name **sonar\_store**  
4. Open and run the following sql scripts in the SQL Server Management Studio. These sql scripts are available in the cloned repository folder inside the folder “**database**”

	

| S no | File name | Purpose |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| 1 | db\_creation\_microsoftSQL.sql| To create t\_shirts and discounts table(prefilled with some values) |
